generator: built-in image_gen (codex exec, gpt-6-astra, reasoning xhigh)
method: Six independent generations sharing one common brief; each variant adds one art direction. Backgrounds only, the in-game layers are overlaid later in the Lab page.
common:
Use case: game background concept art. Create ONE new wide landscape background image (1536x1024) for a vertical four-lane rhythm game.
Image 1 is the in-game HUD frame called the gear. It is overlaid on top of the background at the horizontal center during play. Image 2 is the current in-game screen: the gear covers the central band (about 30% to 70% of the width) over the full height and only the left and right strips of the background stay visible. The current background in Image 2 looks flat, dim and low-detail next to the glossy gear, and that mismatch is the problem to solve.
The new background must look like it belongs to the same game as the gear: the same rendering quality and style (clean, semi-realistic, glossy hard-surface sci-fi illustration with crisp bevels and soft bloom, like premium mobile rhythm game key art) and a palette that relates to the gear's white/silver armor plates, warm gold trim and cyan-blue emissive glow.
Draw the background ONLY. Do not draw the gear, lanes, notes, keys, buttons, gauges, HUD, numbers, text, logos, UI, cockpit, aircraft, characters or a watermark.
Composition: forward-facing first-person flight view. One shared vanishing point at the horizontal center, about 40% from the top, hidden behind the lanes. Keep the central vertical band (30% to 70% of the width) calmer and slightly darker with no strong focal object, because the gear hides it. Put the interesting structures, light and depth cues in the left and right thirds so they read in peripheral vision. Keep important content within the middle 85% of the height because the image is cropped to 16:9.
Values: keep the overall image darker than the gear so its white armor still reads clearly, but lift the shadows to rich deep mid-tones instead of near-black, and give the side areas real detail and contrast. No lens flare or bright light source in the central band.

variants.label: A
variants.title: Painted Liftoff
variants.direction: Liftoff at night, repainted in the gear's style. The craft has just lifted off over a vast airbase. On the ground plane, long runway guide-light lines and grids of city lights converge toward the center vanishing point. Above the horizon, a band of clouds and a starry deep blue-teal sky. Mostly cyan ground lights with a scattering of warm gold lights that echo the gear trim.

variants.label: B
variants.title: Twilight Ascent
variants.direction: Climbing at dusk. The sky blends from deep navy at the top through teal to a thin warm amber-gold glow along the horizon. A sea of clouds below, its rims lit gold from beneath. On the left and right, distant slender silver aerial towers with cyan beacon lights recede toward the vanishing point.

variants.label: C
variants.title: Stratosphere
variants.direction: High altitude above the clouds at night under a bright moon. Deep cobalt sky with faint stars near the top. Below, a luminous white cumulus sea lit by cool silver moonlight whose white rhymes with the gear's white armor. A few small distant white-and-gold sky platforms with cyan lights on the left and right. Keep the center calm.

variants.label: D
variants.title: Launch Bay
variants.direction: Inside a colossal launch tunnel just before exiting. The left and right walls are built from the same armor language as the gear: beveled white and silver plates, gold edge trim and cyan emissive light strips. The walls and floor lines converge toward a soft blue night-sky opening at the center vanishing point. Dark gaps between plates keep the image from getting too bright.

variants.label: E
variants.title: Infiltration Storm
variants.direction: Infiltration: descending into a guarded restricted airspace. Dark indigo-violet storm clouds with distant cyan lightning on the left and right. Below, the rooftops of a vast metallic facility seen at a slight downward angle, with silver panels, gold warning lights and cyan guide lines leading toward the center vanishing point.

variants.label: F
variants.title: Breakthrough Canyon
variants.direction: Breakthrough: sustained low, fast flight through a dense megastructure canyon with no open sky. Tall walls on the left and right carry vermilion-orange emissive panels (the breakthrough identity color) set into white armored structures with gold trim. Thin light streaks run along the walls toward the center vanishing point.
